notes: Estimated interest is now free for everyone. It was marked Premium but switched on by default for new accounts, so free users could turn it off and never turn it back on - and their tracked balances would drift away from their real statements.

Premium members now see the True Cost figures too - what each debt costs per day and in total interest at minimum payments - right in the portfolio table. This was showing on the free debt cards only.

Fixed: leaving the minimum payment blank when editing a debt now estimates it for you, the same as it always has when adding one. Previously clearing that field left you stuck on an error until you typed a number.
